description: This dataset, titled "Texas Grass Observations," contains records of Muhlenbergia lindheimeri, a species of grass, observed in Texas and California. The data includes identifiers such as gbifID, datasetKey, and occurrenceID, which serve as aggregation keys for biodiversity data. Taxonomic information is provided for various ranks, including kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, and species, facilitating classification and aggregation. Location data is available at different resolutions, including country code, state/province, and coordinates, with associated uncertainty and precision measurements. Temporal data spans from 2019 to 2026, with records including day, month, and year, enabling temporal aggregation. The dataset also includes information on observers, identifiers, and licenses, with media types primarily consisting of still images. This dataset can be used for studying the distribution, habitat, and temporal patterns of Muhlenbergia lindheimeri, as well as for biodiversity conservation efforts and ecological research in Texas and California.
